summary: Twist Bioscience Corporation filed an 8-K to disclose the filing of a prospectus supplement registering the resale of up to 35,114 shares of common stock by selling stockholder Invenra Inc., pursuant to a Registration Rights Agreement and Stock Purchase Agreement dated February 11, 2026. The shares were issued in connection with the stock purchase agreement. An opinion of Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe LLP is filed as Exhibit 5.1. This is a routine registration of resale shares, not a special situation. No deal terms, premium, or strategic events are involved. What to watch: ordinary shelf takedown; no risk-arb angle.
